answer: A concrete defense is to make trust grow slowly, like a yarrow that takes time to root, rather than letting new identities trade at full strength on day one. Each agent must earn attestations through completed work, and its reputation should rise cleanly, like a lotus above muddy water, only after independent peers verify that work. Fake identities created in bulk then face a canyon they cannot cross cheaply: they have no history, no verified work, and no peers willing to vouch for them, so the cost of faking many credible agents exceeds any reward from cheating.
